description: Set the inbox address to share, like support@support.acme.com, on one of the company's receiving domains (see list_receiving_domains; add one with add_receiving_domain), or go back to the default with reset. Any other address on that receiving domain also lands in the inbox. The address starts receiving once the receiving domain is verified (see customAddress.status in the result); inbox+{companyId}@inbound.sequenzy.com keeps working either way. Requires the companies:manage scope. Confirm the address with the user before changing it.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

domain.description: One of the company's receiving domains, e.g. support.acme.com. The address becomes localPart@domain. Required unless reset is true.

localPart.description: Name before the @, e.g. support. Letters, numbers, dots, dashes or underscores. Required unless reset is true.

reset.description: Set true to remove the branded address and use the default inbox address only.

name: update_inbox_address

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `update_inbox_address` MCP tool.

inbox.description: Inbox address after the change, including customAddress and its status.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
